The wind roared on his newly opened ears. Even though he walked he knew he was dead and should expect not too much of himself or this hateful living world.

arxiv-2405-01440.title: A Review of Reward Functions for Reinforcement Learning in the Context of Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2405-01440.creator: Ahmed Abouelazm, Jonas Michel, J. Marius Zöllner
arxiv-2405-01440.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning has emerged as an important approach for autonomous driving. A reward function is used in reinforcement learning to establish the learned skill objectives and guide the agent toward the optimal policy. Since autonomous driving is a complex domain with partly conflicting objectives with varying degrees of priority, developing a suitable reward function represents a fundamental challenge.

arxiv-2409-06513.title: Sines, Transient, Noise Neural Modeling of Piano Notes
arxiv-2409-06513.creator: Riccardo Simionato, Stefano Fasciani
arxiv-2409-06513.description: Abstract This article introduces a novel method for emulating piano sounds. We propose to exploit the sines, transient, and noise decomposition to design a differentiable spectral modeling synthesizer replicating piano notes. Three sub-modules learn these components from piano recordings and generate the corresponding harmonic, transient, and noise signals.

arxiv-2410-18754.title: Benchmarking quantum chaos from geometric complexity
arxiv-2410-18754.creator: Arpan Bhattacharyya, Suddhasattwa Brahma, Satyaki Chowdhury, and Xiancong Luo
arxiv-2410-18754.description: Abstract Recent studies have shown that there is a strong interplay between quantum complexity and quantum chaos. In this work, we consider a new method to study geometric complexity for interacting non-Gaussian quantum mechanical systems to benchmark the quantum chaos in a well-known oscillator model.

arxiv-2503-15907.title: Detection for intermediate-mass binary black holes in population III star clusters with TianQin
arxiv-2503-15907.creator: Hanzhang Wang, Shuai Liu, Han Wang, Hong-Yu Chen, Long Wang, Yiming Hu
arxiv-2503-15907.description: Abstract Context. Population III star clusters are predicted to form in unenriched dark matter halos. Direct N-body simulation of Pop III clusters implies the possible formation and merger of intermediate-mass binary black holes (IMBBHs). The gravitational wave signals could be detected by space-borne gravitational wave detectors such as TianQin. Aims.

arxiv-2507-16151.title: SPACT18: Spiking Human Action Recognition Benchmark Dataset with Complementary RGB and Thermal Modalities
arxiv-2507-16151.creator: Yasser Ashraf, Ahmed Sharshar, Velibor Bojkovic, Bin Gu
arxiv-2507-16151.description: Abstract Spike cameras, bio-inspired vision sensors, asynchronously fire spikes by accumulating light intensities at each pixel, offering ultra-high energy efficiency and exceptional temporal resolution. Unlike event cameras, which record changes in light intensity to capture motion, spike cameras provide even finer spatiotemporal resolution and a more precise representation of continuous changes.

pmc-10673125.title: Benchmark Dataset for Training Machine Learning Models to Predict the Pathway Involvement of Metabolites
pmc-10673125.creator: Erik D Huckvale, Christian D Powell, Huan Jin, Hunter N B Moseley, Martin Grootveld, Leonardo Franco
pmc-10673125.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Metabolic pathways are a human-defined grouping of life sustaining biochemical reactions, metabolites being both the reactants and products of these reactions. But many public datasets include identified metabolites whose pathway involvement is unknown, hindering metabolic interpretation.

pmc-10739274.title: SELF- AND PROXY-REPORTED MET NEEDS IN PERSONS WITH DEMENTIA ARE ASSOCIATIED WITH A LOWER HEALTH-RELATED QUALITY OF LIFE
pmc-10739274.creator: Joost Wammes, Holly Laws, Hein van Hout, Janet MacNeil Vroomen, Joan Monin
pmc-10739274.description: This study examined the dyadic association of self and informal caregiver proxy-reported met needs in persons living with dementia on the health-related quality of life (HRQOL). A total of 237 dementia care dyads were included from the Case Management of Persons With Dementia and Their Caregivers Study.

pmc-11563612.title: Epidemiology of cat bites to people in Uruguay: Effects of the age and sex of the victim, season of the year, and the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-11563612.creator: Juan Pablo Damián, Javier Román, Gabriela Willat, Florencia Barrios
pmc-11563612.description: Background:Cat bites to people are an important public health problem. However, very little information exists on the epidemiology of people bitten by cats at the level of an entire country in Latin America. Additionally, the COVID-19 pandemic significantly influenced people’s lives and their relationships with pets, which could potentially affect the frequency of people bitten by cats.

pmc-12444664.title: Treatment patterns, outcomes, healthcare resource utilization, and costs associated with locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck in Japan
pmc-12444664.creator: Kenichi Nibu, Makoto Tahara, Noriko Yoshimi, Ramzi Argoubi, Vanessa Rascon-Velasco, Makan Rahshenas, Sarah Bobiak, Ember Lu
pmc-12444664.description: ObjectiveTreatment patterns and healthcare resource utilization (HCRU) data in patients with locally advanced (stage III to IVB) squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (LA SCCHN) in Japan are limited. This study describes the patient demographics and characteristics, treatment patterns, HCRU, and costs among Japanese patients with newly diagnosed LA SCCHN.

pmc-12815288.title: The prognostic value of peripheral hematological biomarkers in patients with hypersensitivity pneumonitis: A single-center retrospective study
pmc-12815288.creator: Ayshan Mammadova, Zeynep Yalçınkaya, Nilgün Yılmaz Demirci, Haluk Türktaş
pmc-12815288.description: Background/aim:Investigating inflammation-related biomarkers in hypersensitivity pneumonitis (HP) patients may provide valuable insights, particularly in determining their clinical course and prognosis. This study aimed to explore the potential role of peripheral hematological biomarkers in predicting the clinical course and prognosis of HP patients.Materials and methods:This retrospective study included 75 patients diagnosed with HP.

pmc-13005998.title: Livestock grazing boosts plant diversity in the Greater Serengeti–Mara Ecosystem
pmc-13005998.creator: Yustina Kiwango, Rob Venderbos, Yuhong Li, Han Olff, Michiel P Veldhuis
pmc-13005998.description: Intensifying land use is a global threat to biodiversity, and livestock grazing—occupying 26% of terrestrial land—is one of such threats. Designated protected areas are one of the key conservation strategies to halt biodiversity loss, but their effectiveness is debated, in part because of data shortage at relevant spatial scales (>1 ha).
